errors.description: The rear welt pocket that the blueprint shows wrapping into the three-quarter view is outside the tighter documentation crop.
errors.expected: Three-quarter front with the rear welt just visible at the top right, as drawn.
errors.actual: Crop stops at the hip, so the rear welt falls outside the frame.
errors.correction: Optional: widen the crop slightly to the wearer's rear so the back welt re-enters frame.

notes: Adversarial pass on an ABSENCE option, where the critical failure would be a watch pocket appearing anywhere. It does not: the waistband runs clean and unbroken from edge to edge, with no small coin/watch pocket, no welt, no jetting, no buttonhole and no opening at the waistband or just below it. I checked the waistband band specifically at full resolution rather than inferring from the overall look. The front slant pocket that is present belongs to a different field and is drawn in the blueprint, so it is not an intrusion. Three belt loops, crease line and three-quarter orientation all match the drawing. No annotation, numerals, arrows or coloured guide marks in frame.
